contract.text: The 1am check-results job grades the previous day's pick from the MLB feed and updates the local streak.
contract.source: src/bts/cli.py check_results docstring 'Designed to run via cron at 1am ET' (9114224); scripts/cron-setup-pi5.sh 1am line (5ef88b0)

mechanism.text: check_hit looked the batter up only by batter_id in the stored game_pk's boxscore; a wrong game_pk or batter_id returned None, which check_results treats as 'not found or game not final' and exits without grading

residual.text: a pick file with a null game_pk still made check_hit request game/None (HTTP 400) until a6cae41 on 4/04 (I-008)

watchdog.trigger: by 06:00 ET the day after a delivered pick, its pick file still has no hit/miss result and no recorded reason to wait (e.g. suspended game)
watchdog.recovery_assertion: the date carries a hit/miss grade that matches the MLB feed (and the contest ledger when available)

evidence.what: adds a name-and-date fallback to check_hit for a wrong game_pk or batter_id; the body does not say that a live grading run failed
